action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
import time
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Pull and build (just server)
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git pull origin main 2>&1 | tail -3")
print("Pull:", stdout.read().decode())

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria/server && pnpm run build 2>&1 | tail -8")
print("Build:", stdout.read().decode())

# Restart
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 restart areloria 2>&1")
print("Restart:", stdout.read().decode())

time.sleep(12)

# Check ports  
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ss -tlnp | grep node")
print("Ports:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
